title: Lighter South Indian cod curry
summary: Lighter South Indian cod curry is a indian dinner built around cod fillets and light coconut milk, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Lighter South Indian cod curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add cod fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and light coconut milk.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until green beans is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Lighter South Indian cod curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Lighter South Indian cod curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
